about.text:
NetSim Web – browser-based network simulator (Phase 1: foundation + layer 2).
No real IOS, no real network access.
hint.placing: Click the workspace to place the device (Esc = cancel).
hint.cableA: Cable: click the first device and choose a port.
hint.cableB: Cable: click the second device and choose a port.
hint.pduB: PDU: click the destination device (ICMP echo).
hint.delete: Click a device or cable to delete it.
palette.title: Devices and cables
palette.placeHint: Click, then click the workspace – or drag and drop
picker.title: Choose port
sidebar.title: Sidebar

netinfo.empty: No devices yet. Pick a device below and place it.
panel.title: Device

port.name: Port
ip.notAHost: This device has no host stack.
ip.gatewayOffSubnet: The gateway is not in the host's subnet.
toast.noTargetIp: The destination device has no IP address.
ping.noIp: This device has no IP configuration yet.
ping.reply: Reply from {{ip}}: bytes={{bytes}} time={{time}} ms TTL={{ttl}}
ping.noRoute: Destination network unreachable: no route/gateway for {{ip}}.
ping.hostUnreachable: Destination host unreachable ({{ip}}): ARP got no answer.

sim.title: Simulation
cable.problem.rollover: rollover cable only works on console ports
cable.problem.console: console port needs a rollover cable
cable.reject.sameDevice: A cable cannot have both ends on the same device.
cable.reject.plug: The connector does not fit this port.
cable.reject.fiber: Fibre only works between SFP/fibre ports.
cable.reject.unsupported: This cable type is not supported yet.
tx.linkDown: Cannot send on {{port}}: link is down → frame dropped.
rx.collisionRunt: Frame damaged by a collision (runt) → dropped.
csma.backoff: Collision detected (attempt {{attempt}}) → backing off {{slots}} slot times on {{port}}.
hub.collision: Layer 1: Collision! {{count}} transmissions overlap → jam signal on all ports.
hub.repeat: Layer 1: hub repeats the signal from {{port}} to {{count}} other ports.
host.l2.notForMe: Layer 2: destination MAC {{dst}} ≠ own MAC {{mac}} → frame dropped.
host.noIp: Host has no IP configuration → packet dropped.
host.arp.gratuitous: Layer 2: gratuitous ARP ({{ip}} is at {{mac}}) → existing cache entry updated.
host.arp.notMine: Layer 2/3: ARP request for {{ip}} – not my address → dropped.
host.arp.conflict: Duplicate IP address! {{ip}} is also used by {{mac}}.
host.arp.request: Layer 2/3: ARP request for my address {{ip}} from {{sender}} → sending ARP reply (unicast).
host.arp.reply: Layer 2/3: ARP reply: {{ip}} has MAC {{mac}} → added to ARP cache, queued packets are sent.
host.arp.failed: ARP for {{ip}} got no answer after 3 attempts.
host.ip.notMine: Layer 3: destination IP {{dst}} is not my address → dropped.
host.icmp.broadcastIgnored: Layer 3: broadcast echo request is not answered.
host.icmp.echoRequest: Layer 3: ICMP echo request from {{src}} accepted → sending echo reply.
host.icmp.echoReply: Layer 3: ICMP echo reply from {{src}} accepted.
switch.filter: Layer 2: destination is on the ingress port {{port}} → frame filtered (not forwarded).
switch.filter.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination is on the ingress port → frame filtered.
switch.outDown: Layer 2: egress port is down → frame dropped.
switch.unicast: Layer 2: destination MAC {{dst}} known → unicast forwarding on {{out}}.
switch.unicast.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination MAC {{dst}} known → unicast on {{out}}.
switch.flood: Layer 2: destination unknown/broadcast → flooding to {{count}} ports.
switch.flood.learned: Learned MAC {{src}} on {{port}}. Destination unknown/broadcast → flooding to {{count}} ports.
sys.deviceCrashed: Device crashed: {{message}}. The rest of the simulation keeps running.
